title: Campus Registration Rush
description: Network load is rapidly escalating during online course registration.
explanation: At 91.0 Mbps with μ = 50.0 and σ = 5.0, Z = (91 - 50) / 5 = +8.20. This is an extreme anomaly (> 3σ) indicating severe network congestion requiring immediate emergency mitigation.

title: Afternoon Peak Load
description: Calculate the standardized Z-score for the peak afternoon lecture streaming.
question: What is the Z-score for a network load of 62.0 Mbps?
explanation: Z = (62 - 50) / 5 = 12 / 5 = 2.4. A Z-score of 2.4 signifies the load is 2.4 standard deviations above the campus average.

title: Bell Curve Boundary Marker
description: Drag the interactive marker to locate where Z = +2.0 falls on the standard normal distribution.
explanation: Z = +2.0 corresponds to μ + 2σ = 50 + 2(5) = 60 Mbps. In a normal distribution, 97.72% of observations fall below Z = +2.0.

title: Dormitory Traffic Audit
description: Scan the sampled telemetry data to isolate the anomalous packet surge.
explanation: 91 Mbps is visibly detached from the cluster (47-53 Mbps). Compared to baseline μ = 50, σ = 5, Z = 8.2; it represents an unmistakable telemetry anomaly.
